description.en: Declarative tracking policy for scripts/upstream_updates.py: which registry entries automatically track upstream, how each tracked skill's local layout maps to its upstream subtree, what is intentionally excluded, how the engine and the license-blocked replacements are tracked, and which gates decide eligibility versus hold. The registry (catalog/skills.json) stays authoritative for pins/paths/licenses; docs/UPSTREAM-PINS.json stays the pin authority. This file never grants publication: eligible candidates flow to the Root-owned signing/publishing pipeline, held candidates preserve the published version with an actionable repair state.
description.zh-Hans: scripts/upstream_updates.py 的声明式跟踪策略：哪些登记条目自动跟踪上游、每个被跟踪技能的本地布局如何映射到其上游子树、哪些内容被有意排除、引擎与因许可证受阻的替代品如何跟踪，以及哪些门槛决定可发布还是暂缓。登记文件（catalog/skills.json）仍是固定提交/路径/许可证的权威；docs/UPSTREAM-PINS.json 仍是固定提交权威。本文件从不授予发布权：合格候选进入 Root 拥有的签名/发布流水线，暂缓候选保留已发布版本并给出可执行的修复状态。

impeccable.route: sources/impeccable is regenerated only by the pinned two-stage engines/impeccable pipeline; engine updates run through .github/workflows/impeccable-engine-updater.yml; this tracker reports signals and holds, it never constructs an impeccable candidate
impeccable.stableReleaseTagPattern: engine-v<semver>, non-prerelease only, tag must agree with the ENGINE_VERSION in its own tree (validated by the engine updater workflow, not here)

executionModel.eligibleUpdates: complete check/plan/stage in the cloud and flow to the existing Root-owned build/verify/sign/publish pipeline using existing credentials and scoped tokens
executionModel.heldUpdates: preserve the previously published version, record an actionable adaptation state, and never fabricate runtime/native qualification; emulation never sets guest-verified

gates.driftHolds: license drift (mapped license carry or repository root license), permission drift (capabilities/tools/scriptRuntime/pythonPackages), dependency drift (references/dependencies.json, requirements locks) and any execution-fingerprint or instruction-code-fingerprint change on a scripted skill hold the candidate with the published version intact
gates.editorialHolds: showcase/links.json evidence whose exact cited line block does not survive uniquely in a changed file holds (held-editorial-review); a non-mechanical references/PROVENANCE.md shape holds (held-provenance-format)
gates.minimumAppVersion: never raised or lowered by the tracker; a candidate that would need a new minimumAppVersion implies new native behaviour and is held
gates.packageGates: hubcore.validate_package_files applies unchanged to every candidate tree (paths, symlinks, native payloads, sizes, counts, NFC/casefold duplicates, notice preservation, runtime/script consistency)
gates.upstreamEntryGates: upstream tree entries are refused (held-unsafe) on symlink or submodule modes, unsafe names, size caps above hubcore.MAX_FILE_BYTES, and native payload magics; oversized or binary additions are never carried silently

layoutDefaults.floeOwnedNote: declared defaults are documentation and a safety net; the operative rule is that any local file without an upstream correspondence (no fileMapping, no relocation, no path identity, no unique content match) is Floe-owned and preserved byte-identical. RISC-V guest integrations (verify scripts, fixtures, dependency locks, engine bindings) live in these paths.
layoutDefaults.licenseCarryRule: a fileMapping with kind=license is a license carry: its upstream bytes changing between the pinned and resolved commits is ALWAYS held-license-drift (license re-audit), never an automatic carry; unchanged license bytes keep the local file as-is

https://github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill.licenseNote: MIT root LICENSE plus retained per-asset credits; root license drift holds adoption. Full source kit remains on the separate large-source capability channel.

https://github.com/Maxbase91/procurement.licenseNote: MIT root LICENSE plus root NOTICE (author copyright and authorship marks). Both are compared between the entry pin and the resolved head; local UPSTREAM-* copies stay Floe-owned bytes.

https://github.com/alirezarezvani/claude.licenseNote: MIT root LICENSE; local UPSTREAM-LICENSE.txt copies are Floe-owned bytes and are never regenerated automatically

https://github.com/anthropics/k12-teache.licenseNote: Apache-2.0 root LICENSE plus root NOTICE; the selected skill subtree also carries its own LICENSE/NOTICE, mapped as license fileMappings. All four byte streams are watched.

https://github.com/anthropics/knowledge-.licenseNote: Apache-2.0 root LICENSE plus finance/LICENSE and legal/LICENSE; the directory license is the copied evidence for those guides and the root LICENSE (which carries an unrelated trailing fragment) is the evidence for human-resources guides. finance/NOTICE, legal/NOTICE, human-resources/LICENSE and human-resources/NOTICE are declared prospective watch paths: absent at the pin, watched for appearance, removal or drift. Data-only; no connector or command is carried. Customer-support guides carry customer-support/LICENSE. Operations vendor-review carries the root LICENSE. customer-support/NOTICE, operations/LICENSE, operations/NOTICE and root NOTICE are absent at the reviewed pin and explicitly watched for appearance/removal/drift. Sales guides carry exact sales/LICENSE bytes; sales/NOTICE is absent at the reviewed pin and watched for appearance, removal or drift. Small-business guides use the exact root LICENSE; small-business/LICENSE and small-business/NOTICE are absent at the pin and watched for appearance/removal/drift.

https://github.com/anthropics/skills.licenseNote: no repository-root license; each carried skill subtree ships its own LICENSE.txt (Apache-2.0), mapped per skill to references/licenses/UPSTREAM-LICENSE.txt

https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking.licenseNote: MIT root LICENSE only; the skill file carries no separate license declaration.

https://github.com/datadrivenconstructio.licenseNote: MIT root LICENSE plus root NOTICE.md; the NOTICE excludes the book and CC BY-NC CWICR compilation. Both are compared between the entry pin and the resolved head; local UPSTREAM-* copies stay Floe-owned bytes.

https://github.com/genspark-ai/genoffice.licenseNote: Apache-2.0 root LICENSE plus root NOTICE. Both are compared between the entry pin and the resolved head; local UPSTREAM-* copies stay Floe-owned bytes.

https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable.licenseNote: Apache-2.0 root LICENSE; engine stable releases are tracked by engine-v<semver> tags, never by main HEAD

https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-ski.licenseNote: no license at the reviewed pin; pinned in docs/UPSTREAM-PINS.json but referenced by no admitted entry: curation/license-signal only, never auto-admits a skill and never copies bytes

notTracked.note: Exact registry partition: tracked(71)+engineManaged(1)+watchOnly(5)+builtins(4)+firstParty(5)=86. Native first-party guides have no external upstream; external skills retain scheduled GitHub Actions tracking.

watchOnly.reason: first-party replacement of a license-blocked original (no license at the reviewed pin); sources/doc-coauthoring/references/PROVENANCE.md records that NO upstream bytes were copied. Signal-only: report whether a license appeared upstream; copying stays prohibited and re-adoption is a Root curation decision.

versioning.rule: an accepted content change always proposes a NEW version (patch bump of the registry versionTarget, re-bumped while the version exists anywhere in packages/<id>/, the feeds or the publication ledger); identical candidate contentDigest means no-change and never a bump; same (id,version) digest replacement is refused by construction
